ORTHOGONAL POLYNOMIALS (p.785)
22.10.12  P_n(\cos\theta)=\dfrac1\pi\int_0^\pi(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta\cos\phi)^n d\phi
22.10.13  P_n(\cos\theta)=\dfrac{\sqrt2}\pi\int_0^\pi\dfrac{\sin(n+\frac12)\phi\,d\phi}{(\cos\theta-\cos\phi)^{1/2}}
22.10.14  L_n^{(\alpha)}(x)=\dfrac{e^xx^{-\alpha/2}}{n!}\int_0^\infty e^{-t}t^{n+\frac\alpha2}J_\alpha(2\sqrt{tx})\,dt
22.10.15  H_n(x)=e^{x^2}\dfrac{2^{n+1}}{\sqrt\pi}\int_0^\infty e^{-t^2}t^n\cos\Big(2xt-\dfrac n2\pi\Big)dt
22.11. Rodrigues' Formula
f_n(x)=\dfrac{1}{a_n\rho(x)}\dfrac{d^n}{dx^n}\{\rho(x)(g(x))^n\}
The polynomials given in the following table are the only orthogonal polynomials which satisfy this formula.
Columns: f_n(x) | a_n | rho(x) | g(x)
22.11.1  P_n^{(\alpha,\beta)}(x) | (-1)^n2^nn! | (1-x)^\alpha(1+x)^\beta | 1-x^2
22.11.2  C_n^{(\alpha)}(x) | (-1)^n2^nn!\,\dfrac{\Gamma(2\alpha)\Gamma(\alpha+n+\frac12)}{\Gamma(\alpha+\frac12)\Gamma(n+2\alpha)} | (1-x^2)^{\alpha-\frac12} | 1-x^2
22.11.3  T_n(x) | (-1)^n2^{n+1}\dfrac{\Gamma(n+\frac12)}{\sqrt\pi} | (1-x^2)^{-\frac12} | 1-x^2
22.11.4  U_n(x) | (-1)^n2^{n+1}\dfrac{\Gamma(n+\frac32)}{(n+1)\sqrt\pi} | (1-x^2)^{\frac12} | 1-x^2
22.11.5  P_n(x) | (-1)^n2^nn! | 1 | 1-x^2
22.11.6  L_n^{(\alpha)}(x) | n! | e^{-x}x^\alpha | x
22.11.7  H_n(x) | (-1)^n | e^{-x^2} | 1
22.11.8  He_n(x) | (-1)^n | e^{-x^2/2} | 1
22.12. Sum Formulas
Christoffel-Darboux Formula
22.12.1  \sum_{m=0}^n\dfrac1{h_m}f_m(x)f_m(y)=\dfrac{k_n}{k_{n+1}h_n}\dfrac{f_{n+1}(x)f_n(y)-f_n(x)f_{n+1}(y)}{x-y}
Miscellaneous Sum Formulas (Only a Limited Selection Is Given Here.)
22.12.2  \sum_{m=0}^n T_{2m}(x)=\tfrac12[1+U_{2n}(x)]
22.12.3  \sum_{m=0}^{n-1}T_{2m+1}(x)=\tfrac12U_{2n-1}(x)
22.12.4  \sum_{m=0}^n U_{2m}(x)=\dfrac{1-T_{2n+2}(x)}{2(1-x^2)}
22.12.5  \sum_{m=0}^{n-1}U_{2m+1}(x)=\dfrac{x-T_{2n+1}(x)}{2(1-x^2)}
22.12.6  \sum_{m=0}^n L_m^{(\alpha)}(x)L_{n-m}^{(\beta)}(y)=L_n^{(\alpha+\beta+1)}(x+y)
22.12.7  \sum_{m=0}^n\dbinom{n+\alpha}{m}\mu^{n-m}(1-\mu)^mL_{n-m}^{(\alpha)}(x)=L_n^{(\alpha)}(\mu x)
22.12.8  H_n(x+y)=\dfrac1{2^{n/2}}\sum_{k=0}^n\dbinom nk H_k(\sqrt2x)H_{n-k}(\sqrt2y)
22.13. Integrals Involving Orthogonal Polynomials
22.13.1  2n\int_0^x(1-y)^\alpha(1+y)^\beta P_n^{(\alpha,\beta)}(y)dy=P_{n-1}^{(\alpha+1,\beta+1)}(0)-(1-x)^{\alpha+1}(1+x)^{\beta+1}P_{n-1}^{(\alpha+1,\beta+1)}(x)
22.13.2  \dfrac{n(2\alpha+n)}{2\alpha}\int_0^x(1-y^2)^{\alpha-\frac12}C_n^{(\alpha)}(y)dy=C_{n-1}^{(\alpha+1)}(0)-(1-x^2)^{\alpha+\frac12}C_{n-1}^{(\alpha+1)}(x)
22.13.3  \int_{-1}^1\dfrac{T_n(y)dy}{(y-x)\sqrt{1-y^2}}=\pi U_{n-1}(x)
22.13.4  \int_{-1}^1\dfrac{U_{n-1}(y)dy}{(y-x)\sqrt{1-y^2}}=-\pi T_n(x)
22.13.5  \int_{-1}^1(1-x^2)^{-1/2}P_n(x)dx=\dfrac{2^{3/2}}{2n+1}
22.13.6  \int_0^\pi P_{2n}(\cos\theta)d\theta=\dfrac\pi{16^n}\dbinom{2n}{n}^2
22.13.7  \int_0^\pi P_{2n+1}(\cos\theta)\cos\theta\,d\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4^{2n+1}}\dbinom{2n}{n}\dbinom{2n+2}{n+1}
